releases.name: v3.0.1
releases.body:
> [!NOTE]
> This release fixes agent-mode startup and performance problems, tightens certificate and update verification, and corrects several Docker, Swarm, and backup behaviors. Agents now skip manager-only work, and updates are always verified.

### Agent mode

- Skip manager-only scheduled jobs in agent mode (#4779, @gongloo)
- Skip manager-only RBAC and OIDC backfills on agent startup (#4776, @gongloo)
- Avoid redundant SQLite prepared statement cache and read pool on agent (#4778, @gongloo)
- Strip CR and LF from agent tunnel values in logs (#4771, @kmendell)

### Security and updates

- Reject legacy edge SPIFFE client certificates (#4795, @kmendell)
- Remove the `newSelfUpdater` preview and always verify updates (#4773, @kmendell)
- Bump `kit.getarcane.app/acfs` to v0.10.3 (#4796, @kmendell)

### Docker and containers

- Time out Docker disk usage requests (#4774, @kmendell)
- Match digest-strategy containers to tag update records (#4772, @kmendell)
- Pass enabled features into Docker backend builds (#4793, @kmendell)

### Stacks and configuration

- Keep stack `.env` across git syncs and editor saves (#4783, @NullishUsername)
- Skip global env file writes when unchanged or

releases.name: v3.0.0
releases.body:
> [!NOTE]
> This release adds a redesigned dashboard and activity center, live upgrade progress, customizable views, and expanded backup and GitOps capabilities. It also brings substantial performance, security, agent, and interface improvements, alongside breaking changes to legacy protocols and configuration.

### Upgrades, updates, and image security
- Stream upgrade progress and logs for individual and all-environment upgrades, aggregate activity across environments, improve update status popovers, and finalize upgrade jobs after external manager upgrades (`743a49e`, `387b17c` (#4539), `8fbf5b8`, `e63f8f5`; @kmendell).
- Improve update details with commit notes for next-channel updates, image release notes, image creation dates and versions, detail-page update status and pull actions, and Docker Hardened Image status. Add vulnerability-based update blocking and improve risk scoring (`b55472a`, `948386d`, `163f854` (#4665), `2e00ddc` (#4708), `0d8373f` (#4692), `0fbfac4` (#4760), `835b5ca`; @kmendell).
- Add queued-agent updates and update counts to Update all; configure parallel agent upgrades and move the all-environments limit into environment settings (`494e56e` (#4766), `74

releases.name: v2.17.3
releases.body:
> [!NOTE]
> This release fixes image update planning and Compose image reporting, improves container sorting, and hardens request logging and startup behavior.

### Containers and images
- Sort containers by name without regard to case. (#4620, @kmendell)
- Show the configured image for Compose services. (#4638, @kmendell)
- Drop stale image-level pending updates before planning. (#4637, @kmendell)

### Reliability and security
- Warn at startup when using direct agent mode. (#4619, @kmendell)
- Redact secrets from logged request paths. (#4623, @kmendell)
- Mount the CA bundle into the Rustic container using a staged volume. (#4621, @kmendell)
- Skip cancellation of a superseded workflow when its instance is missing. (#4624, @kmendell)

releases.name: v2.17.2
releases.body:
> [!NOTE]
> This release fixes API error handling and Git-sync redeploys, and improves image uploads, vulnerability links, and backup behavior.

### API and proxy
- Return 4xx responses for build workspace path errors (#4595, @jmrplens), unknown records and invalid requests (#4596, @jmrplens), and Docker not-found and conflict errors on more routes (#4598, @jmrplens).
- Return 404 for manager-side routes targeting an unknown environment (#4597, @jmrplens).
- Keep proxied request bodies readable while the agent responds (#4592, @jmrplens).

### Images and deployments
- Allow Safari uploads of `.tar.gz` and `.tar.xz` images ([3bf2c362f56439b19853d0576d96b87b0aafa7bb], @kmendell).
- Skip stored update state for digest-pinned images (#4610, @kmendell).
- Build project images before redeploying after Git sync (#4611, @kmendell).
- Warn when deprecated Arcane images are running (#4585, @kmendell).
- Snapshot the service spec before saving changes in the service editor (#4603, @kmendell).

### Security, backups, and documentation
- Link vulnerability IDs to their advisory databases (#4583, @kmendell).
- Skip local Rustic pruning when no local backups exist (#4584, @kmendell).

releases.name: v2.17.1
releases.body:
> [!NOTE]
> This release fixes manual job and updater behavior, improves Compose and workspace handling, and resolves a Rustic container certificate issue.

### Jobs and updates
- Require jobs to be enabled in saved settings before allowing manual runs (#4550, @grootbro).
- Allow manual updater runs to proceed even when updates are opted out (#4564, @kmendell).
- Resolve orphaned job run activities on startup (#4572, @kmendell).

### Compose and workspaces
- Respect the name set in a Compose file instead of the project name (#4561, @kmendell).
- Use mount-time environment and volume settings in the workspace cache listener (#4563, @kmendell).

### Backups
- Trust Arcane’s CA roots inside the Rustic container (#4554, @Mczubi).
